column1: # Hole fixtures — every content producer's path, exercised in BOTH modes.
# Why this file exists: the 1.11.2 check found that `extract` on a snapshot-shared (copy-on-write) stream
# printed the note and exited 2 but wrote no sidecar and ignored --refuse-holes, while the tool page
# promised both. The fixture that finds it took ten minutes and already existed in the M1 report -- it had
# only ever been run in default mode. A fixture verified for the note alone verifies almost nothing.
# Each row is a RECIPE, not a stored image: punch `offset` on a sparse copy of `image`, run `command`, and
# compare against the two expectation columns. `image_sha256` is the content hash of the SOURCE image, so a
# row cannot silently drift onto a different volume.
#   id  producer  image  image_sha256  offset  path  expect_default  expect_refuse
